subject: Contractor tax classification, W-9 delivery, and invoice routing

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: New contractor — tax form + final invoice attached

Hi Rishi,

Hope you’re well — we’re finishing up the July engagement for the Solvance integration team. I attached our final invoice (Invoice 2027-07-08) and a completed W-9 for Solvance AI. We are a US LLC taxed as a disregarded entity (EIN included on the W-9).

Could you confirm whether Redwood needs any additional payee paperwork for 1099 processing and whether ACH routing is acceptable for payment? Also confirm whether the EIN on the W-9 matches your vendor record — we recently updated the legal name and want to avoid payment delays.

Attachments: invoice_2027-07-08.pdf (invoice), solvance_w9_signed.pdf (W-9)

Thanks,
Samira Gupta
Finance Lead, Solvance AI
samira.g@solvance.ai
+1 415-555-0192
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samira Gupta <samira.g@solvance.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New contractor — tax form + final invoice attached

Hi Samira — thanks for sending these over. A quick checklist so we can clear payment: 

1) Confirm entity classification: Is Solvance AI operating as a US single-member LLC (disregarded entity) or a corporation for tax reporting? If disregarded LLC using EIN, we will treat it as 1099-NEC eligible. If corporation, we typically do not issue 1099s.

2) W-9: the W-9 you attached looks complete but we need the printed legal name to match the payee name on the invoice and vendor record. I took a quick look and the invoice shows "Solvance Tech" while the W-9 shows "Solvance AI, LLC" — can you confirm which is the legal remittance name?

3) ACH: yes, we accept ACH. Please provide a bank letter or voided check for account verification (bank_letter_account_verification.pdf is fine). ACH template is available at the Redwood vendor portal — I linked it in the onboarding doc below.

Monica — looping you in for any additional vendor setup requirements or 1099 flags. Laura — flagging legal only if the payee name / EIN mismatch persists.

Related link: https://docs.redwood.com/finance/vendor-onboarding-checklist

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
From: Samira Gupta <samira.g@solvance.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New contractor — tax form + final invoice attached

Hi Rishi — thanks for the quick response. Apologies for the naming inconsistency — the legal entity is "Solvance AI, LLC" (EIN 12-3456789). The invoice PDF has the product brand name on the header; I attached a corrected invoice with legal remittance name and a bank verification letter (bank_letter_account_verification.pdf).

Attachments: invoice_2027-07-08_revised.pdf, bank_letter_account_verification.pdf, solvance_w9_signed.pdf (resubmitted)

Let me know if you need an authorized signature on the W-9 or any additional attestations for beneficial owner.

Best,
Samira
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Samira Gupta <samira.g@solvance.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: RE: New contractor — tax form + final invoice attached

Hi Samira — thanks for the corrected docs. I reviewed the W-9 and bank letter. A couple of items before I can schedule ACH: 

- Vendor record: I updated the payee name to "Solvance AI, LLC" in our vendor portal, but our AP system requires the remittance name on the invoice to exactly match the vendor record for automated routing. The revised invoice you sent is OK.
- EIN match: The EIN on the W-9 matches what we need.
- ACH payee setup: please complete the ACH authorization template (I attached a blank ACH_auth_template.docx in the vendor portal). If you prefer, you can reply with a signed ACH authorization PDF and we will proceed.
- 1099 classification: based on the W-9 and your confirmation, we will treat payments for July 2027 as 1099-NEC reportable. If your tax election changes, notify us before year-end.

I can schedule payment for Wed 07/28 if we receive signed ACH authorization by EOD Friday 07/23. Otherwise, payment will occur in the next cycle.

Attachments referenced: ACH_auth_template.docx (portal link)

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Accounts Payable Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Samira / Monica — quick update: Samira just confirmed via a signed ACH authorization (received 07/22 09:12) and the revised invoice. Monica, please proceed with the 07/28 run if all validations pass. Laura — no legal issues noted, but please advise if we should retain the signed W-9 in a different folder for audit.

Payment plan: pay invoice 2027-07-08 (revised) via ACH on 2027-07-28. AP to mark as 1099-NEC for calendar 2027.

Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround.

Rishi
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
